rationale: Clear motor-vehicle collision claim: rear-end impact causing vehicle damage and policyholder injury.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at a red light yesterday at ~8:15 AM by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. The vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat) and policyholder suffered whiplash and sprained wrist. High-severity claim with documented injuries and vehicle loss; other driver's insurance info available on police report.
